There are real risks: innocent people get caught up in violent prison dynamics, and turning punishment into deliberate suffering makes the system as barbaric as the crimes we condemn. I’d prefer life without parole plus stronger victim-centered supports and accountability measures, or restorative approaches where possible, rather than trading one form of cruelty for another. I hear your anger, though — victims deserve justice and safety — we just have to ensure our response doesn’t violate basic human dignity.
